title: Time bound for the Boolean shift function
statement: For every Boolean word $w$, the machine with no work tapes that emits one false bit for each input bit and then emits $w$ computes the function $x \mapsto 0^{|x|} \mathbin{+\!\!+} w$ on every Boolean word $x$ in time $(|w|+2)(|x|+1)$.
hypotheses_covered: the computation claim holds for every Boolean input word $x$
replaced:
For every word $w$, the shift machine for $w$ computes the function mapping each
input $x$ to $0^{|x|} \mathbin{+\!\!+} w$ within time $(|w| + 2)(n + 1)$ on inputs
of length $n$; this time bound is monotone and linear in $n$.
